description: Fetch up to 10 URLs in parallel and return each as clean markdown. Same handler/fallback chain as the fetch tool, with a smaller per-URL length budget. Use after a search to pull several sources in one call.

allowArchive.description: Allow labeled historical snapshots after live retrieval fails; disabled by noCache unless explicitly enabled

maxAgeSeconds.description: Oldest acceptable cached retrieval in seconds; 0 forces retrieval (default 3600)

maxLength.description: Maximum characters to return per URL (default 20000)

maxTier.description: Stop at this tier (1-5, default 5). Lower = faster but fewer fallbacks.

noCache.description: Skip session and shared caches and fetch live content

timeoutMs.description: Overall retrieval deadline in milliseconds, including downloads (default 25000)

name: fetch_batch
title: Fetch multiple URLs
